United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO)

description.narrative: Under the overall authority of the Assistant Director-General for the Natural Sciences Sector (ADG/SC), direct supervision of the Director of the UNESCO Office in Almaty, as well as in coordination with the Programme Specialist for Natural Sciences in Almaty Office, the incumbent will assist in contributing to the design, coordination and implementation of activities carried out under UNESCO´s Natural Sciences Major Programme II in the Central Asian Region in view of supporting the Member State of Kazakhstan in its effort to implement its National Development Plan (NDP), the United Nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework (UNSDCF), and contribute to the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development. In particular, s/he will be responsible for providing professional and technical support, research and analysis, with an emphasis on the national context to develop, implement and evaluate programme initiatives to promote learning and sustainable societies, and support the Member State of Kazakhstan in advancing science, technology, innovation, research and engineering to address contemporary environmental and societal challenges towards the implementation of the UNESCO Recommendation on Open Science. H/she shall work as part of the Interdisciplinary team in the UNESCO Office in Almaty, collaborating with relevant stakeholders and with technical guidance from the Natural Sciences Programme Divisions at UNESCO Headquarters, and the Natural Sciences Programme Specialists at the UNESCO Multisectoral Regional Offices in Asia and the Pacific.
